title: Engenheiro de projetos civil sênior (líder de projetos)

Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site:#Vem Pra AtvosAqui,diversidade é essencial! Experiência em gestão de projetos de engenharia, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais ou de infraestrutura; Experiência na interface com áreas internas e stakeholders externos; Conhecimento em metodologias de gestão de projetos (ex.: PMI/PMBOK); Vivência com planejamento, cronogramas, CAPEX, controle de custos e gestão de riscos; Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (MS Project, Primavera ou similares); Familiaridade com normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis (ex.: ABNT, ISO) e no uso de novas tecnologias/IA para acompanhamento de projetos.Informações adicionais: Nosso modelo de trabalho éhíbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório emPinheiros/SP.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.Benefícios que fortalecem nossa energia Na Atvos, acreditamos quecuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.Confira o que você encontra por aqui: PLR anual , de acordo com seu desenvolvimento Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Vale Refeição Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento Auxílio Creche Previdência privada Total Pass– para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental Seguro de Vida Programa Indicação de Talentos Atvos– indique profissionais que compartilhem nosso propósito e seja reconhecido por issoAqui,crescer com consistênciasignifica unirinovação, sustentabilidade e propósitopara gerar impacto positivo nas pessoas, nos negócios e no planeta.Se você acredita em um futuro movido por energia limpa e por gente que faz a diferença,

title: Coordenador de suprimentos
description:

Definir a modalidade contratual mais adequada para cada contratação (PMG, preço global, turn key, preço unitário, empreitada e por administração), garantindo segurança, competitividade e mitigação de riscos; Conduzir negociações estratégicas com fornecedores, buscando as melhores condições comerciais, qualidade e geração de saving; Desenvolver e ampliar a base de fornecedores, promovendo maior competitividade e novas oportunidades para a companhia; Analisar composições de custos e orçamentos de obras, utilizando referências como SICRO e SINAPI para apoiar negociações e garantir aderência ao orçamento; Elaborar e acompanhar o planejamento estratégico de compras, alinhando demandas das áreas ao orçamento disponível; Monitorar indicadores da área, como Saving, Lead Time, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), gestão orçamentária e cumprimento do cronograma das contratações; Gerenciar o orçamento das categorias sob sua responsabilidade, buscando continuamente oportunidades de redução de custos; Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a performance da equipe de Compradores e Especialistas; Garantir o cumprimento das políticas de Integridade, Compliance e do Sistema de Gestão Antissuborno, além de realizar a gestão dos riscos relacionados às operações sob sua responsabilidade.O que buscamos: Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Administração, Finanças ou áreas correlatas; Sólida experiência em suprimentos e contratação de obras de infraestrutura e projetos rodoviários; Conhecimento em contratos de construção civil, incluindo modalidades como PMG, preço global, turn key, empreitada e preço unitário; Vivência em negociação estratégica com fornecedores e gestão de contratos; Conhecimento em gestão orçamentária, análise de custos e indicadores de desempenho; Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes.Diferenciais: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Suprimentos, Engenharia de Custos ou áreas correlatas; Experiência no segmento de concessões rodoviárias; Conhecimento das tabelas SICRO e SINAPI; Especialização em técnicas de negociação; Vivência em gestão estratégica de fornecedores e contratos de alta complexidade.Desafios da posição: Garantir contratações estratégicas para obras e projetos de infraestrutura, assegurando qualidade, prazo e competitividade; Promover redução de custos por meio de negociações eficientes e gestão do TCO; Desenvolver e fortalecer a base de fornecedores da companhia; Assegurar o cumprimento dos indicadores e metas da área de Suprimentos; Liderar a equipe, promovendo desenvolvimento, engajamento e alta performance.Competências desejáveis: Liderança e gestão de pessoas; Visão estratégica e foco em resultados; Excelente capacidade de negociação; Inteligência emocional e boa comunicação; Senso de dono; Ética e governança; Resiliência e capacidade de tomada de decisão; Trabalho em equipe e relacionamento interpessoal.Benefícios: PLR; Vale Refeição (Flash); Plano de Saúde (Seguros Unimed); Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Wellhub (antigo Gympass); Programa de saúde emocional; Descontos em farmácias; Formato híbrido (3 dias presenciais e 2 dias remotos).

title: Finance supervisor
description:

This team ensures that all supply chain/cost transactions, analysis and reporting are accurate and compliant in line with Kenvue guidelines. In addition, understanding of the SC processes, systems and ability to effectively frame and communicate with senior leaders will be important to success and to the team as a whole. The Finance Supervisor may work with Inventory or Principal pillars, being responsible for the following: PICC Principal Responsibilities: Oversee and manage intercompany transactions, regional pricing and profit elimination Support tax strategy for principal sourcing companies with statutory and managerial P&L analysis being a key partner with the leadership for the Integration with Kimberly Clark Coordinate and perform annual costing, ICP, markup setup process Support development of financial forecasts, perform closing activities and analyses of results Support analysis of Intercompany price variances Influence the business to streamline the Principal flows and act as a key player on the principal deployment within the new S4 SAP Hana environment PICC Inventory Responsibilities: Oversee and manage the Inventory for the LATAM region being closer to the Finance Director and the Planning Director on the Inventory strategy for the organization Lead the SLOB, FAA FP&A processes, DOS calculation, Net Inventory Reports Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning to identify and mitigate risks (Regional and Global Planning Governance) Partner closely with Finance teams (BUF, FP&A, Make, Source) to have a strong understanding of end-to-end costing variation and inventory drivers Lead FAA analyses and closing activities for FAA supply chain groups Lead forecast cycles to influence meeting inventory targets for a leaner supply chain General responsibilities: Ensure compliance with all local government and company regulations, policies, and procedures Business partnering (i. E. Tax, Compliance, Supply Chain, Leadership Teams) Share business and financial best practices/procedures across the region Focus on process improvement and standardization Promote collaboration and use best practices to provide strategic analytic support to the team and organization Participate in other special projects as needed Perform other duties as assigned Lead teams What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications A minimum of a bachelor's degree is required in Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or Business Management 6–8 years of experience Cost and inventory accounting experience Strong financial modeling skills Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions Ability to identify, recommend and implement process improvements Ability to lead small teams Desired Qualifications Experience with SAP, Microsoft Office, and Business Intelligence tools Experience as a Finance or related business partner Advanced English preferred (Spanish is a plus) Strong communication and presentation skills Compliance background and experience

title: Assistente de controladoria sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Assistente de controladoria sênior em são josé do rio preto. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

REQUISITOS Ensino Superior em Ciências Contábeis em andamento (a partir do 4º semestre) ou Técnico em Contabilidade completo; Experiência de 1 a 2 anos em rotinas administrativas, financeiras ou contábeis (contas a pagar/receber, conciliação, escrituração); Extração e análise de relatórios em ERP (preferencialmente Sienge); Noções de plano de contas e centro de custos; Excel intermediário (filtros, tabelas, PROCV); Organização de documentos em GED; Fundamentos de documentação contábil; Atenção aos detalhes, organização, proatividade, comunicação assertiva e agilidade.ATIVIDADES Conferência de Saldos (Suporte à Conciliação): Conferir os saldos finais das contas contábeis e transitórias através do cruzamento direto entre os relatórios baixados do ERP Sienge e os extratos mensais disponibilizados pelo Financeiro para identificar e mapear as diferenças ou lançamentos pendentes antes do fechamento oficial; Cobrança de Documentação (Saneamento): Identificar a ausência de comprovantes físicos ou digitais que justifiquem a movimentação financeira através do cruzamento analítico de relatórios para cobrar ativamente o Departamento Financeiro ou a Engenharia, garantindo o lastro documental do balanço; Preparação de Lotes (Interface Co-sourcing): Compilar, organizar e zipar os relatórios financeiros, medições aprovadas e guias pagas através da estruturação padronizada no servidor de rede (GED) para viabilizar o envio tempestivo e sem erros da base de dados à contabilidade externa terceirizada; Apoio Operacional em Planilhas: Alimentar as planilhas auxiliares de controle contábil (ex: controle de ativo imobilizado, adiantamentos ou despesas) através da extração de dados brutos do Sienge e uso de Excel intermediário para fornecer bases limpas e mastigadas que acelerem as análises dos Analistas Júnior e Pleno; Checklist de Conformidade de Lotes: Realizar a varredura final nos lotes de fechamento através de uma matriz de verificação (Checklist) para garantir que não sejam enviados à contabilidade externa processos com informações truncadas ou sem a devida conciliação prévia validada pelo Financeiro; Apoio e Triagem Fiscal (Backup Operacional): Realizar a triagem de documentos fiscais (XML/PDF), identificar retenções na fonte (INSS, ISS, IRRF) e conferir dados cadastrais para apoiar o fluxo de lançamentos no ERP Sienge, atuando como suporte à área fiscal conforme a demanda e necessidade do setor; Suporte à Conformidade de Fornecedores: Auxiliar na verificação de validade de Certidões Negativas de Débitos (CNDs) de empreiteiros e fornecedores, garantindo que a documentação de suporte fiscal esteja adequada para mitigar riscos de responsabilidade solidária; Rotinas Administrativas Gerais: Executar outras tarefas associadas ao ambiente organizacional de acordo com as solicitações e instruções da supervisão para assegurar suporte às necessidades operacionais da Empresa.DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA Modalidade: Presencial; Regime de contratação: CLT; Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 8h às 18h (com 1h12 de intervalo).BENEFÍCIOS Vale-transporte; Vale-alimentação; Convênio Médico Coparticipativo (opcional); Seguro de Vida.

title: Forestry operations manager brazil (engenheiro florestal)
description:

The Green Branch is seeking a dedicated Forestry Operations Manager (Engenheiro Florestal) to lead the implementation of our large-scale reforestation projects in Brazil. This role requires a forest engineer who will oversee operational execution, manage implementation partners, and ensure the successful restoration of degraded landscapes. Key activities also include site visits, monitoring activities, feasibility studies, and land eligibility assessments to drive the success of our initiatives. About The Green Branch The Green Branch is a developer of large-scale reforestation projects in Brazil, creating a portfolio of high-quality carbon credit projects to supply the Voluntary Carbon Market. We work alongside nature and local communities to restore degraded land into resilient forests. Our goal is to create permanent forest cover by planting biodiverse forests with native and productive species, including agroforestry and plantations, striving to bring resilience to the landscape. For more information:Location: Brazil, São Paulo, with frequent field travel Key responsibilities: Technical Operations Leadership: Apply deep technical knowledge of large-scale forestry operations to evaluate standard operating procedures, operational plans, execution quality, and partner performance. You know how to evaluate local implementation partners, what key forestry aspects need to be assessed to ensure good project implementation, and can indicate to TGB if operational plans are of sufficient quality to reach our reforestation goals. Partner Oversight & Coordination: Be the primary point of contact for operational partners, rigorously evaluating their work on paper and in the field. Lead meetings with operational partners and review all documentation, proposals, reports, plans, and deliverables they submit. Proactively communicate with partners, follow through on agreements, and raise issues to TGB when something is off. Technical Scoping & Contract Review: Define the technical scope of work and operational KPIs for partner contracts. Review all operational agreements, to ensure that all forestry aspects are fully covered and field risks are mitigated prior to signing. Field Supervision & Quality Assurance: Conduct farm evaluations from a rigorous forestry standpoint to assess execution quality on the ground. Also, when needed, supervise soil sampling, tree measurements, and stand inventories, acting as the operational lead in the field, ensuring all field data collection meets the strict standards required for third-party carbon verification audits. Technical documentation: Develop monitoring plans, sampling protocols, standard operation procedures, and project reports to support internal decision-making and certification processes. Review and ground-truth forestry designs and species lists to ensure they are operationally feasible and aligned with local site conditions and will provide the expected carbon, timber, and biodiversity impacts. External representation: Represent The Green Branch in meetings and communications with external stakeholders, including investors, auditors, and landowners. Lead these interactions with confidence, ensure follow-through on any commitments made, and escalate issues internally when needed. Profile and skills: Based in Brazil (São Paulo). Education : Degree in forest engineering (required). Forestry experience & knowledge : At least 5 years of experience in large-scale forestry operations in Brazil with hands-on knowledge of forestry field operations such as soil preparation, tree planting, species selection, tree harvesting, and stand assessments. Experience at major industrial forestry or plantation companies (e.g. Suzano, Bracell, Cenibra , or similar) is strongly preferred. Technical Writing & Protocols: Experience drafting and reviewing forestry standard operating procedures (SOPs), field monitoring plans, sampling protocols, and technical project reports. Implementation Partner Management : Experience managing large-scale implementation partners that handle a broad operational scope. This includes This includes defining the operational terms of their contracts, reviewing their reports and proposals, performing field verification to check their data against actual ground results, and making sure they meet quality standards. Stakeholder Management : Experience communicating with external stakeholders, such as investors, auditors (e.g., FSC/VCS), and landowners, ensuring their needs are attended to and any concerns are addressed. Languages: Fluent in Portuguese (required) and English (required). Mindset: You are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset that can work independently and raises issues proactively. You are comfortable operating with limited guidance in a fast-moving environment. Mobility & Travel: Willingness to travel extensively within Brazil for site visits and partner coordination. Valid Brazilian driver's license (CNH Category B) is required. Nice to have: Experience at or with a carbon project developer (e.g. VCS/CCB project experience, monitoring, or carbon credit origination). Experience with forest certification standards and compliance (FSC and/or PEFC/Cerflor) Experience with agroforestry and/or reforestation with native species. Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company environment, where priorities shift and you're expected to wear multiple hats. Experience with GIS tools (QGIS, Li DAR, SAR). What we offer: A leadership role in a fast-growing impact-driven company dedicated to large-scale ecosystem restoration. The opportunity to make a real impact on (large-scale) forest restoration, climate, and biodiversity. A dynamic work environment with autonomy and professional growth opportunities. Collaboration with a multinational team of experts in reforestation and carbon markets. Competitive salary and benefits package. Start date: 1 st of September 2026 (flexible for the right candidate). Application deadline: 17th of July, 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and will contact shortlisted candidates directly. Ready to get your hands dirty and help us build resilient native forests? Send your CV and motivation letter to

title: Regional sales representative
description:

SC — Regional Sales Representative Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business DevelopmentPosition Details Job Title:SC — Regional Sales Representative Department:Sales & Business Development — LATAM Reports To:Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM Location:Santa Catarina, Brazil Work Arrangement:Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory Employment Type:Full-Time Travel Required:Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)Role Overview The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines. Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.Key Responsibilities Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations. Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory. Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards. Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments. Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel. Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities. Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities. Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company. Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information. Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.Qualifications & Requirements Required Experience:Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the Io T segment. Educational Background:Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields. Communication Skills:Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Customer-Centric:Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals. Location:Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.Preferred Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, Lo Ra, satellite communication, and antennas. Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil. Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial Io T, or connected mobility verticals. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and standard productivity software. Spanish language skills a plus.About Quectel Quectel is a global Io T solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.Life at Quectel LATAM At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.Industries & Applications Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:Smart Metering & Utilities —Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions. Asset Tracking & Logistics —Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture —Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Smart Cities & Infrastructure —Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring. Industrial Io T & Automation —Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring. Connected Mobility & Automotive —Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T —Connected appliances, energy management, security.Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus —Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).Explore Quectel — Links & Resources We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. Caso se sinta confortável, você pode nos informar se se identifica como uma pessoa com deficiência. Para oferecer o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos futuros colegas constroem relacionamentos sólidos com os clientes e oferecem soluções centradas no cliente. Por fim, estamos procurando colegas que construam parcerias e trabalhem em colaboração com os outros para atingir objetivos comuns. Se você se juntar a nós, fará parte de uma empresa internacional de sucesso global, líder em seu setor em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e muito mais. Nós nos vemos como uma rampa de lançamento para a carreira — um lugar para você se desenvolver rapidamente com trabalho real, experiência real e oportunidades reais de desenvolver habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, treinamentos e orientação de membros seniores da equipe. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nosso pessoal que realmente nos permitem oferecer o melhor. Fundada em 1853, a SIG está sediada em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e é listada na SIX Swiss Exchange.

Job Purpose The role supports DP World Global Sanctions Programme in Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations. The individual will work as part of Sanctions Compliance team and will conduct compliance assessments for international cross-border transactions and third party relationships, with a specific focus on ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations related to economic sanctions and trade compliance (e. G., export controls) across DP World Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations. This helps ensure that DP World conducts its business at the highest level of integrity and in full compliance with the applicable national and international laws and regulations, as well as the Group’s internal policies, professional standards and best industry practices. Most decisions are expected to be made independently and with a high degree of accuracy. Identify and assess key compliance risks associated with escalations at second level review. Communicate with business line when further information and/or documentation is required as part of compliance alerts analysis. Document 2nd-level escalations risk analysis and decisions rationale. Escalate cases with increased compliance risks to the relevant Compliance Manager. Develop initial risk assessment reports and proposals for mitigating measures. Contribute to improving automated screening solutions: reduce false positive, mitigate sanctions risks and increase efficiency. Assist in identifying gaps and training opportunities for escalations that come through the compliance workflows. Assist with training and providing guidance DP World’s Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations. Develop reports and responses for Compliance and Business management, audit and investigations inquiries. Maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders to foster a collaborative approach to embedding a strong culture of trade compliance. Assist in addressing internal and external compliance related requests. To act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working;promoting and demonstrating positive behaviours in harmony with DP World’s Founder’s Principles, values and culture;ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities;

title: Solutions architect
description:
Confira a vaga para Solutions architect em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B )WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB (or another No SQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.HOW YOU’LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
description:
Confira a vaga para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

description:

DEMAND PLANNER Dy Star is seeking to fulfill an important role to support the supply chain for Brazil. The successful candidate will have 2 years international planning and replenishment experience. This is an on-site role in Sao Paulo (not open to remote or hybrid work). Must be able to communicate in English with the Americas Regional Headquarters in the United States and with the Global Headquarters in Singapore- must have good skills in writing and speaking. Job Summary: Perform Demand Planning and Replenishment activities of Finished Goods based on Actual Sales, Forecast, Inventory on hand, material in transit, open Purchase Orders and Production Lead Time in order to determine the optimum size of inventory in accordance with Global and Regional parameters. Place Purchase Orders in accordance to Demand Planning needs, and guarantee correct follow up of each one of them, as to accomplish timely delivery of the material to the required plants. Control and manage all aspects of planning activities, maintain correct inventory levels to support company goals and customer service needs, as well as avoid/minimize over stock, unhealthy inventory and short supply Assist with maintenance of data bases in MRP and guarantee Open POs are maintained at minimum levels. Attend priority and planning meetings, outage coordination meetings and scheduled review meetings and be prepared to actively participate as required. Supervisory Responsibilities: None Job Responsibilities: Prepare correct information for the monthly planning meeting to support the monthly planning activities, ensuring the participation and communication with Sales, Marketing, BM and related areas together with the SCM team with the objective to propose replenishment at adequate quantities and guarantee delivery of products in timely manner in accordance to Global and Regional requirements. Elaborate and update the planning report to be presented in S&OP meetings, which contains: products, sales, forecast, inventory in all plants related to the planning scope, production schedule per product, material in transit, open purchase orders, new orders to be placed, overstock and stock transfers (between plants) Elaborate and update the purchase orders report as to follow each line item in the purchase order with pre allocation or allocation date, or production schedule, shipping details, documents corresponding to each shipment (invoice, packing list, B/L, COA, etc.) Follow DOA (Delegation of Authority) process when entering Purchasing Requisition or Purchase Orders. In case of airfreight orders needed, request corresponding authorization as per DOA, before placement Ensures critical analysis of inventory levels to support Company goals and manages the development of creative solutions to anticipate inventory short supply issues Prepares Unhealthy Inventory Reports monthly to be presented to Business Managers and Sales Teams so Unhealthy Inventory can be properly managed, and necessary actions are timely addressed Creates, monitors, and maintains S&OP metrics and key performance indicators, identifying resulting risks and opportunities Helps to develop advanced analytical tools and reporting figures to support the entire planning and purchasing process Facilitate cross-functional communication among the Business Units, Supply Chain and Local teams in support of major Planning & Purchasing initiatives, factory productivity, inventory levels, distribution, transportation, etc. Reviews short/mid/long term demand plans, follows up on their execution with Sales team and Business Managers to align forecast outlook. Analyzes internal demand stream information and categorizes according to demand patterns. Gets consensus forecast among Sales/Marketing/Business Managers and Supply Chain. Aligns Production Schedule of Suppliers and Production Facilities with Purchasing Plan in order to take the best benefit of freight charges and shipping opportunities. Manages and coordinates Process Improvements initiatives based on Lean Manufacturing concepts Coordinates development and homologation processes of new Service Providers Experience and Education Requirements: • A degree in International Trade, International Business, International Relations or related degree and • 2 years of experience in International Planning and Replenishment or equivalent experience. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: • Excellent analytical skills • Excellent computer skills, with advanced skill in MS Excel • Bilingual Portuguese-English required • Excellent oral and written communication skills • SAP (Not mandatory but nice to have it)

● Experiência prática comprovada em emulsões e sistemas emulsionáveis, familiaridade com desafios de formulação e aplicação de bioinsumos para o agronegócio; ● Experiência prática comprovada em síntese, otimização e escalonamento de formulações encapsuladas; Experiência em manutenção industrial (preferencialmente em usinas); Conhecimento em manutenção preventiva, corretiva e preditiva; Vivência com equipamentos como bombas, redutores, caldeiras e sistemas hidráulicos; Ensino médio completo. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.Tereos no Brasil A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Project manager em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Data quality analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Data quality analyst em caraguatatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

JOB DESCRIPTION Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy. The Pre-screening tests typing speed (45-60wpm), reading comprehension and pattern recognition. Finding those who are sharp and can navigate ambiguous technical jargon would be a great fit for the role. Day to Day Responsibilities Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality. Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE Must Haves: Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities). C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency. 3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred) Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts. Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources. Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team. Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.

title: Supervisor de vendas
description:
Empresa está contratando Supervisor de vendas em sorocaba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada. Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes. Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times. E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers! O que te espera no dia a dia? Gestão dos consultores da loja: acompanhar as vendas, dar suporte, contribuir com o desenvolvimento da equipe e garantir a entrega dos resultados; Responsável portodos os processos administrativos da equipe; Desenvolvimentoe acompanhamento das estratégias comerciais; Vendas de produtos financeiros e acionamentos junto à equipe; Divulgação dos produtos; Responsável pela abertura e fechamento da loja. Esperamos que você tenha: Necessário que o Supervisor de Vendas possua experiência com gestão de equipe de vendas de qualquer produto; Necessário ter experiência com vendas e trabalhado com metas; Desejável atuação com vendas de multiprodutos e experiências com vendas ativas por telefone e presenciais; Perfil do Supervisor de Vendas: Proativo, resiliente, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, senso de urgência, foco no cliente e nos resultados de vendas. Ensino Médio Completo; Conhecimento no Pacote Office; Informações adicionais Local de trabalho: São Paulo - Boituva Jornada: 100% presencial Horário de trabalho: Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h Sexta feira das 08h às 17h Remuneração: Salário Fixo Remuneração Variável Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar: Plano de saúde Unimed; Plano odontológico Met Life; Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação; Programa de Incentivo Educacional: Pagamos 100% da sua graduação, pós graduação, curso de idiomas ou cursos rápidos; Seguro de vida; Vale transporte; Acesse a Wellhub (antiga gympass), uma plataforma que oferece uma rede de parceiros para atividades físicas e de saúde, ajudando você a manter um estilo de vida ativo e saudável. Paceria com a plataforma da Psicologia Viva, em que você e seus dependentes conseguem fazer sessões de terapia 100% online e gratuito; PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica. E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm! Todo mundo é bem-vindo, investimos em uma cultura de respeito, diversa e inclusiva! Esperemos você em nosso time #somoshelpers! vem ser você também

title: Design specialist
description:
Nova oportunidade para Design specialist em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About us Keeta is a global technology company on a mission to help people eat better and live better. As part of one of the world's leading technology groups, we operate food delivery and marketplace platforms that connect millions of customers, merchants, and riders every day. We are building the future of food delivery -- combining cutting-edge technology, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to customer experience. The Role In this role, you will create high-quality offline and digital design assets that drive merchant acquisition, enhance customer engagement, and ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints, working closely with Marketing, Growth, and Commercial teams to bring strategic briefs to life. What You'll Do Design marketing materials including point-of-sale assets, out-of-home advertising, promotional materials, merchant activation kits, and rider branding, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain visual consistency across all marketing materials while adapting global brand assets to local market needs and business objectives. Prepare production-ready artwork and coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to ensure technical specifications, print quality, and timely delivery. Develop creative assets for product launches, local marketing campaigns, events, and brand activations that support Commercial, Marketing, and Operations teams. Collaborate with Marketing, Growth, and Trade Marketing teams to translate strategic briefs into effective visual communication solutions. What We're Looking For Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and In Design. Experience designing printed materials, point-of-sale assets, outdoor advertising, and marketing collateral. Strong understanding of branding, typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy. Knowledge of print production processes and technical specifications for graphic materials. A strong portfolio demonstrating experience in branding, marketing materials, and campaign execution. Creative professional with strong execution skills and meticulous attention to detail. Highly organized, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for deliverables. Able to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities. Advanced English proficiency. Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Advertising, or related fields. Availability to work on-site in São Paulo. Preferred Qualifications Experience in retail, technology, marketplace, or food delivery companies. Certifications in Motion Design, Branding, or Graphic Production. Mandarin proficiency is a plus. What We Offer International and collaborative work environment. High ownership and autonomy. Opportunity to work on complex business challenges at scale. Career growth in one of the world's leading technology companies. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Benefits Meal and food allowance (Caju Card)Transportation allowance Health and dental insurance Life insurance Childcare assistance How to Apply If you're excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply through Linked In and submit your resume in English. By applying, you acknowledge that your information will be processed securely and may be shared with Keeta and its global affiliates as part of the recruitment process.

title: Líder motorista
description:
Nova oportunidade para Líder motorista em olímpia. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Que desafio temos para você?Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder Motorista para atuar no time de Herbicida.Quais as responsabilidades? Elaborar a logística das áreas de aplicação de herbicida; Acompanhar a aplicação herbicida; Calibrar os equipamentos de pulverização; Realizar gestão e desenvolvimento de equipe; Realizar apontamentos das áreas tratadas.Quais os requisitos? Formação Técnica em Agrícola, completa; CNH D; Experiência na área de herbicida. MOPP (Desejável).Qual localidade? Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.Sobre a TereosCom visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. Acreditamos que a capacidade humana é ilimitada e nos desafiamos sempre.RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:Gerenciar a carteira de Crédito e Recebimento, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas internas, normas corporativas e metas da área. Realizar análises de crédito utilizando a metodologia dos 5 Cs, demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros para suportar decisões de concessão, renovação e prorrogação de crédito. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e participar dos Comitês de Crédito, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas relacionadas à gestão de risco. Garantir o cumprimento dos processos de crédito, cobrança e recebimento, acompanhando indicadores, carteira de pedidos e pendências para aprovação ou reprovação de crédito. Assegurar a formalização, controle e monitoramento das garantias de crédito, incluindo CPRs, hipotecas, alienações fiduciárias, penhores, cessões, contratos, duplicatas e demais instrumentos de mitigação de risco. Supervisionar o monitoramento de garantias, contratos, lavouras e operações vinculadas ao agronegócio, mitigando riscos da carteira. Desenvolver relacionamento com clientes, cooperativas, tradings e principais players do agronegócio, compreendendo as particularidades regionais e apoiando negociações de crédito. Realizar visitas preventivas e negociações junto aos clientes, acompanhando planos de ação, contratos e cumprimento das obrigações financeiras. Atuar em parceria com as áreas Comercial, GCDs, ATVs e demais stakeholders, apoiando decisões relacionadas à gestão da carteira e mitigação de riscos. Analisar indicadores e relatórios gerenciais, propondo melhorias, acompanhando planos de ação e contribuindo para a evolução dos resultados da área. Ministrar treinamentos, apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico da equipe interna e Comercial e compartilhar boas práticas relacionadas à Política de Crédito e Recebimento. Participar de reuniões distritais, treinamentos e fóruns corporativos, disseminando informações estratégicas e alinhando ações com as equipes de campo. Utilizar sistemas corporativos, incluindo o Força de Vendas, para gestão da carteira, acompanhamento de processos e suporte às decisões de crédito. Atuar com foco em governança, conformidade, gestão de riscos e melhoria contínua dos processos de Crédito e Recebimento, garantindo segurança financeira para o negócio.REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:Superior Adm, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas; Inglês - Intermediário; Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas relacionadas (mandatório); Excel Avançado (mandatório); Conhecimento em Power BI (Desejável)PRINCIPAIS BENEFÍCIOS:Assistência Médica; Assistência Odontológica; Refeitório no local; Vale Alimentação; Fretado; Previdência Privada; Gympass; PLR; Auxílio Filho Excepcional; Auxílio Material Escolar.

Strong understanding of resource coordination, service governance, and operational control. Experience managing multi-stakeholder delivery models involving clients, partners, and technical teams. Background in IT services such as IMAC, ITAD, deployment, smart hands, hands & feet, or data centre services. Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, escalations, and service performance under pressure. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Comfortable working across time zones and in a matrixed environment.    COMPETENCIES Background in ITIL or similar service management frameworks. Experience supporting enterprise clients across Latin America. Knowledge of ITAM, deployment, wifi surveys, hands & feet support, or data centre relocation services. Experience working in a multinational, matrixed organization.      WORKING ENVIRONMENT    At Evernex, you will help deliver reliable, customer-focused IT services across a global operating model. Aqui, você será desafiado(a) a entregar o seu melhor diariamente e a se tornar um(a) profissional de destaque no mercado, dominando o design de interfaces e sistemas complexos. Nosso ambiente é colaborativo, exigente e focado no crescimento de quem está disposto a construir soluções de alto impacto.Suas responsabilidades: - Atuar em projetos Web e Mobile desafiadores de ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até a entrega; - Prototipar interfaces intuitivas e elegantes, com foco em usabilidade, escalabilidade e impacto; - Desenvolver e manter design systems que garantam consistência e eficiência; - Colaborar de forma próxima com designers, desenvolvedores e times de produto para alinhar soluções às necessidades dos clientes e do negócio; - Documentar o design de forma detalhada, garantindo uma transição fluida para desenvolvimento.Por que trabalhar na Peak? Porque o que se aprende aqui não é fácil de aprender em outro lugar. Trabalhamos com produtos digitais estratégicos para empresas grandes, em projetos onde design tem peso de negócio, não onde a tela é o fim, mas onde ela é a alavanca de um resultado maior. Quem busca progresso profissional consistente, em escala que ainda permite proximidade real com decisões e fundadores, encontra aqui um terreno difícil de replicar.Requisitos - Experiência sólida em design de produtos digitais (mínimo de 3 anos para pleno e 5 anos para sênior); - Expertise em Figma e design responsivo, com habilidade para criar protótipos de alta fidelidade e organizar arquivos detalhados; - Conhecimento de design systems, UI kits e documentação técnica; - Capacidade analítica e prática para resolver problemas complexos com soluções simples e eficientes; - Interesse genuíno em aprender, se desenvolver e contribuir para elevar o nível do time.Desejável - Experiência em projetos de redesign de sistemas complexos; - Conhecimento básico de frontend para facilitar a comunicação com desenvolvedores; - Experiência em startups ou projetos voltados para tecnologia e inovação.

Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation APhibro Animal Health Corporationé uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais. A posição deAuxiliar Técnico de Laboratórioé um componente importante de nosso time de Qualidade localizado em Guarulhos.Detalhes de posição Auxiliar na execução de análises laboratoriais microbiológicas, químicas e físico‑químicas relacionadas a caldo fermentado, apoiando as atividades do laboratório por meio da preparação de materiais, reagentes, registros e amostragens, sempre sob acompanhamento técnico e em conformidade com as normas de BPL, BPF e segurança.Responsabilidades chave Realizar análises microbiológicas e/ou químicas e/ou físico‑químicas em caldo fermentado, tais como: Testes de p H; Viscosidade; Crescimento microbiano; Dosagens por HPLC, espectrofotometria, entre outras, sempre sob acompanhamento. Executar verificações e aferições rotineiras de equipamentos laboratoriais (ex.: p Hmetro), sob acompanhamento. Preparar meios de cultura, realizar testes de PME, avaliar cepas produtoras e/ou microrganismos estranhos por meio de microscopia. Preparar esfregaços e inocular meios de cultura, aplicando corretamente as técnicas de esterilização e assepsia. Realizar amostragem em biorreatores de bancada, sob acompanhamento. Verificar e/ou aferir balanças e realizar leituras ambientais conforme procedimentos estabelecidos. Preparar reagentes e soluções de uso rotineiro no laboratório. Manter atualizados os registros analíticos, formulários e demais documentos da área. Preparar, lavar e organizar materiais e vidrarias, quando necessário. Manter a área de trabalho limpa, organizada, identificada e em conformidade com os requisitos de BPL. Reportar ao superior imediato a necessidade de materiais de consumo, bem como solicitações de manutenção e/ou calibração de equipamentos, garantindo a confiabilidade dos resultados analíticos e o atendimento às normas de BPL. Cumprir rigorosamente as normas de Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL) e Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP), consultando a SDS (Ficha de Dados de Segurança) e utilizando corretamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs). We are looking for an experienced accounting professional with strong technical and data skills to join our global Accounting team. In this role, you'll prepare journal entries, account reconciliations, and revenue data packages that keep our books accurate, auditable, and US GAAP compliant — while writing the SQL and building the automation that makes those processes scalable as we prepare for public company readiness. You'll report to a US-based Revenue Accounting leader (Eastern Time) and partner daily with accounting, data, and payment reconciliation colleagues across the globe. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable posting a journal entry in an ERP and querying a data warehouse — and who gets energized by fixing broken processes, not just running them. What You'll Do Prepare complete, review-ready journal entries across revenue, accounts receivable, payment provider settlements, chargebacks/refunds, taxes, and intercompany — with full supporting detail for ERP posting Prepare account reconciliations, flux analyses, and supporting schedules for monthly, quarterly, and annual close Write and maintain SQL queries against our data warehouse to extract and validate the data behind accruals and ASC 606 revenue recognition Support payment service provider (PSP) reconciliations — validating settlement, refund, chargeback, and fee data across geographies and currencies, and flagging discrepancies Document processes end-to-end and support SOX readiness, responding to internal and external audit requests as the preparer with full traceability from source to output Identify manual, error-prone steps and automate them — including with AI-enabled tooling — partnering with Data Engineering, IT, and Fin Tech teams What We're Looking For ~8 years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on journal entry preparation and month-end close ownership Accounting degree with CRC or equivalent professional qualification (CPA-equivalent) Solid working knowledge of US GAAP; hands-on ASC 606 revenue recognition experience is a major plus Strong SQL skills — able to write and adapt queries against large-scale data warehouses (Big Query or similar) Proficiency with an ERP system (Net Suite, SAP, Oracle or similar): chart of accounts, journal entry posting, validation, and drill-down analysis Experience supporting internal or external audits; exposure to SOX controls and documentation Fluent English — this role works daily with a US-based team during Eastern Time hours Nice to Have Big 4 or large multinational (Fortune 500-scale) background; IPO or public company readiness experience Industry experience with complex, high-volume revenue models (tech/marketplace, retail, media, manufacturing) Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and scripting for automation Who Thrives Here Someone gritty and curious who gets into the weeds, asks questions, and comes with proposed solutions. We're moving fast toward a bigger goal: priorities pivot, hours can stretch during peak periods, and feedback is direct. If you like ambiguity, ownership, and building processes that didn't exist yesterday, you'll fit right in! What we offer Competitive compensation package Comprehensive medical insurance coverage. Meal allowance Dental Insurance Hybrid setting Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

title: Global assistant manager - economic sanctions & trade compliance
description:
Nova oportunidade para Global assistant manager - economic sanctions & trade compliance em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job PurposeThe role supports DP World Global Sanctions Programme in Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations.The individual will work as part of Sanctions Compliance team and will conduct compliance assessments for international cross-border transactions and third party relationships, with a specific focus on ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations related to economic sanctions and trade compliance (e.g., export controls) across DP World Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations.This helps ensure that DP World conducts its business at the highest level of integrity and in full compliance with the applicable national and international laws and regulations, as well as the Group’s internal policies, professional standards and best industry practices.The role requires strong knowledge of international Sanctions and Export Controls laws, experience with logistics operations, handling controlled dual-use and military goods, as well as problem-solving and analytical skills. Most decisions are expected to be made independently and with a high degree of accuracy.Key Accountabilities Perform sanctions and trade compliance due diligence of third parties and international cross-border transactions to support DP World’s Global Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations. Identify and assess key compliance risks associated with escalations at second level review. Communicate with business line when further information and/or documentation is required as part of compliance alerts analysis. Document 2nd-level escalations risk analysis and decisions rationale. Escalate cases with increased compliance risks to the relevant Compliance Manager. Develop initial risk assessment reports and proposals for mitigating measures. Contribute to improving automated screening solutions: reduce false positive, mitigate sanctions risks and increase efficiency. Assist in identifying gaps and training opportunities for escalations that come through the compliance workflows. Assist with training and providing guidance DP World’s Freight Forwarding / Logistics operations. Develop reports and responses for Compliance and Business management, audit and investigations inquiries. Maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders to foster a collaborative approach to embedding a strong culture of trade compliance. Assist in addressing internal and external compliance related requests. To act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviours in harmony with DP World’s Founder’s Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities; understanding and following DP World’s Code of Conduct and Ethics policies. To perform other related duties as assigned.Qualifications, Experience and Skills Bachelor's degree. Third-party due diligence, sanctions screening experience. Monitor compliance metrics, audit findings, and operational deviations. Drive corrective and preventive action plans, ensuring accountability and traceability. Lead process reviews and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen operational controls. Ensure the effectiveness of CCTV monitoring operations and related security controls. Oversee image review activities, evidence management, and incident documentation processes. Support investigations by conducting root cause analysis and identifying preventive measures. Ensure compliance with access control procedures and physical security protocols. Conhecimento desejável:   ● Experiência e Conhecimento em sistemas de liberação controlada aplicados a RNAi, fungos, bactérias, vírus entomopatogênicos ou metabólitos bioativos sensíveis;   ● Vivência prática com estabilidade, shelf-life, proteção e desempenho de ativos biológicos encapsulados;   ● Experiência em desenvolvimento, otimização e escalonamento de formulações com potencial de aplicação industrial e comercial;   ● Atuação prévia em projetos de pesquisa aplicada desenvolvidos em parceria com empresas, startups ou centros de inovação;   ● Familiaridade com desafios regulatórios, produtivos e de aplicação de bioinsumos no contexto agrícola;   ● Produção técnico-científica relevante (artigos, patentes, relatórios técnicos ou desenvolvimento tecnológico) na área de encapsulação, nanobiotecnologia ou sistemas de liberação controlada.
